Chocolate Banana Protein Pancakes
By: Katie
Published: Thursday, August 5, 2010 - 11:40am

Ingredients




3 tablespoons Coconut Flour
3 tablespoons water
3/4 cup egg whites
1/2 teaspoon baking powder
1/2 scoop of chocolate protein powder
1/2 frozen or regular banana
1 tablespoon of peanutbutter and Maple Syrup
Mix these together and nuke in microwave for topping!

Preparation

1 Mix all Ingredients In a Blender 2 Cook on skillet or griddle, makes about 5-6 pancakes!

About


Healthy and Delish! Perfect for a post workout meal!
